findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: make_csv_file, translate_page, get_feedback_reply · Private data: count_text, make_calendar_file, make_csv_file, translate_page · Public sink: count_text, submit_feedback · Destructive: submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: make_csv_file, translate_page, get_feedback_reply · Private data: count_text, make_calendar_file, make_csv_file, translate_page · Public sink: count_text, submit_feedback · Destructive: submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
